item.title: Juneteenth celebrations take center stage at Levitt Pavilion - Levitt Pavilion
item.description: Community members from across the Metroplex gathered at Levitt Pavilion on Saturday for an early Juneteenth celebration, highlighting diversity and Black culture within North Texas.
